steps.title: Suppression start
steps.rule: Tanks stay together south-west of centre; everyone else spreads along the west and south edges, each on their own spot, clear of the whirlwinds.

MainTank.rule: South-west of centre with the off tank.

OffTank.rule: South-west of centre with the main tank.

steps.title: Eruptions: stack centre
steps.rule: Everyone but the tanks stacks in the centre to bait the first Eruption together.

steps.title: Eruptions: step north-east
steps.rule: Step a little north-east as one group.

steps.title: Eruptions: split by gaol
steps.rule: Split: gaol group to the north-east, the rest north-west, so the Eruptions land apart.

steps.title: Eruptions: east
steps.rule: Shield healer and melee step east to bait the last Eruption.

steps.title: Feather Rain spread
steps.rule: Off tank, regen healer and physical ranged north-east; the rest south-east, each on their own spot.

steps.title: Main tank follows the gaol
steps.rule: Main tank goes to the gaol's north-east side.

steps.title: Light Pillar bait 1
steps.rule: With the Light Pillar marker, bait it south-east, away from the group.

steps.title: Light Pillar bait 2
steps.rule: Bait the next pillar further east.

steps.title: Main tank takes the tether
steps.rule: Main tank runs south-west to stretch the Mesohigh tether.

steps.title: Dodge Landslide 1
steps.rule: Party steps north-east, out of the Landslide line.

steps.title: Dodge Landslide 2
steps.rule: Party steps back east, out of the second line.

steps.title: Regroup north-east
steps.rule: Everyone regroups north-east for the Flaming Crush and Super Cyclone.
